quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's dominant performance against Victor Wembanyama in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Jokic had 37.3 points per game, 10.9 rebounds, 9.1 assists.
quotes.quote: Jokic's stats against Wembanyama in seven games in the NBA: 37.3 points per game, 10.9 rebounds, 9.1 assists. Remember the last time they played was that game in April that went to double overtime when Jokic had 40 points and 13 assists and he hit that unbelievable Sombor shuffle that was the biggest shot of the game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Ivica Zubac's improved conditioning and defensive performance
quotes.excerpt: Zubac believes he got a little complacent in LA and really tried to be aggressive this summer.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: In talking to folks with the Pacers, Zubac believes he got a little complacent in LA and really tried to be aggressive this summer in getting into good condition. I hate even saying it, but it happens every year. He and his wife had a baby in the winter, so I think he's been, he and his wife, and I do think I don't think he was playing poorly last year, but his defense I do think slipped a little bit.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Don't. Just don't. You're about to give some BS explanation, go on.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's potential interest in playing for Cameroon
quotes.excerpt: I would love to go play for Cameroon and see if we could qualify for the Olympics.
quotes.quote: If Joel Embiid said, I know I played for the Americans and won a gold medal, I would love to go play for Cameroon and see if we could qualify for the Olympics or even qualify for the World Cup, I think FIBA would be inclined to let him do it. The Sixers would go crazy, but that's an example of the time.
